title: Robin in the Hood
style: Phonk with hyper-speed bounce, chopped hats, rattling claps, and a sprinting bassline; verse rides tense and clipped, pre-chorus opens into rising callouts, chorus slams into gang shouts and a warped chant. Vocal delivery is dry, doubled on key lines, with delay throws on the hook and frantic ad-libs. Siren-like risers, vinyl grit, and glitch bursts. Bright, punchy, and mean., fake, rock, bounce
